text:
olivia: RC candidate 2026-04-07-c7 (build 7f3a) ready for promo. Can we get a quick sign-off/any blockers?

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Promotion request received for rc/candidate-7 -> prod. Requested by olivia. CI: green, smoke: pending. Pin: none.
sam.release: grabbing smoke now, will run canary set. ETA ~8m.
qa_jordan: running regression suite against canary image. Posting failures here if any.
oncall-mike: FYI saw a small infra blip in preprod 30m ago, investigating whether trailing jobs caused KV cache thrash.
olivia: noted, remind infra if it's correlated with the last autoscale tweak. Also we should pin the artifact if promo goes ahead.
infra-jen: checking logs now. Preprod spike looks like a transient GPU allocation delay, not storage. No recent kernel pushes.
sam.release: canary deploy started 2 instances (5% traffic). Initial health OK, 1/120 errors on inference path at t+3m, probably retry noise.
qa_jordan: found one flaky test around streaming cutoff. Reproduced locally, opening a small PR to tighten the timeout: https://git.internal/redwood/rc-fixes/pull/142
product-anya: timeline? we expected this RC to land before tomorrow's demo but not at the cost of broken streams.
eng-lead-rahul: prefer stability. If QA needs PR merged + quick rebuild, hold promo until validated. Can we do a patch build and a limited canary after merge?
olivia: agree. Plan: hold full promotion. Pin production traffic to current prod artifact. Create hotfix branch, merge PR142, push patched RC and run canary. Sam, can you cut a pinned candidate and queue promotion-on-pass?
sam.release: will cut rc/candidate-7-hotfix-1 from 7f3a + PR142 cherry-pick. Will pin tag as 7f3a-hotfix1 and queue promo only after smoke passes.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: New promotion queued: rc/candidate-7-hotfix-1 -> prod (pin: 7f3a-hotfix1). Canary: 5% for 15m, rollback threshold: 2% errors or 3x latency.
oncall-mike: recommend extending canary window to 30m given recent flakiness and KV cache warmups. Also watch memory growth on host-03.
eng-lead-rahul: extend to 30m, agreed. Add an extra monitoring hook: trace sampling on route /v1/stream.
infra-jen: added trace hook and a temporary alert for host-03 OOM-rate > 0.5/min.
qa_jordan: will re-run streaming regressions on hotfix build once CI artifact is published.
product-anya: updated release notes draft with a note about streaming timeout fix and canary window. Will merge when QA signs off.
sam.release: hotfix build published: digest sha256:abcd1234hotfix. Starting canary now.
sam.release: canary status t+10m: no errors, p95 latency unchanged.
qa_jordan: running final smoke now, looks clean so far.
olivia: if canary stays green at t+30m we promote full traffic. Lock change window for 21:00-22:00 UTC today for full promos.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary passed. Scheduling full promotion to 21:00 UTC. Promotion will pin artifact 7f3a-hotfix1.
oncall-mike: oncall will be listed in release notes and on pager during promo. I'll be available.
eng-lead-rahul: rollback plan: immediate manual rollback via deploy-bot promote previous artifact (prod-stable) and route traffic back. Keep rollback runway 30 minutes after promo.
olivia: thanks all. I'll post final release notes and close the thread after promo completes. :thumbsup:
